display.purpose: The page's one headline, on the hero card.

title.purpose: A column's name, the amount of a card's lowest price, the booking panel's total. A price in a week list is body text at weight 500.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: The hero card, the list's sheet, the booking bar, an open menu.

shadows.name: button-hover
shadows.purpose: Under a primary button while the pointer is on it, in the season's accent.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: State changes of controls, 0.2s to 0.25s. Reduced motion turns transitions off.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action of a card or bar.
components.css: .ds-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 3rem; padding: 0 1.5rem; border-radius: 999px; background: #3b587c; color: #fff; font-family: Jost, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-button:hover { box-shadow: 0 0.5rem 1.25rem -0.5rem #3b587c; } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3b587c; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Season Switch
components.description: One pill; only the chosen season shows its name.
components.css: .ds-season { display: inline-flex; padding: 3px; border: 1px solid #7c878f; border-radius: 999px; background: #fff; } .ds-season button { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.375rem; min-width: 2.375rem; min-height: 2.375rem; padding: 0 0.5rem; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: none; color: #5a666e; font-family: Jost, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; } .ds-season [aria-pressed='true'] { padding: 0 0.875rem 0 0.625rem; background: #3b587c; color: #fff; } .ds-season button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3b587c; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Price
components.description: A free week in the list: plain accent text, a soft tint on hover.
components.css: .ds-price { display: inline-grid; align-items: center; min-height: 2.125rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; border-radius: 999px; color: #3b587c; font-family: Jost, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 500; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s; } .ds-price:hover { background: #e2e8f0; } .ds-price:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3b587c; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Chosen Price

narrative.overview: The site looks like the living room of the apartment it rents: light walls, pale wood, soft furniture and space between things. The free weeks and their prices are the point, so the list is the quietest, clearest thing on the page. The design language (shapes, spacing, type scale, behaviour) is shared by every deployment; the theme (colours and typeface) is a deployment's content, and these values are the demo's.
keyCharacteristics: Light grey ground, white surfaces, a little pale oak.
One muted accent, and it is the season: navy in winter, emerald in summer.
Round controls and cards, but a photo keeps its straight edges.
Few lines: space separates, a hairline only between the rows of a list.

rules.name: The One Season Rule
rules.body: A page shows one accent, the current season's.

rules.name: The Measured Pair Rule
rules.body: Text meets 4.5:1 against what it sits on and a control's edge 3:1, in both seasons.

rules.name: The Nothing Bold Rule
rules.body: No text weight above 500. Emphasis comes from size, colour or position.

rules.name: The Figures Rule
rules.body: Prices and dates use tabular figures and are right-aligned in a list.

dos: Do keep the ground light and let white surfaces and space do the separating.
Do use the season's accent for what a visitor can act on, and nothing else.
Do measure every colour pair of a new theme in both seasons before using it.
Do right-align prices and use tabular figures.
Do keep a photo's edges straight and put text on a card in front of it.
donts: Don't use a dark ground or a dark gradient over a photo.
Don't set text heavier than weight 500.
Don't use bright, saturated accents; a season's colour is muted.
Don't draw boxes and rules where space is enough.
Don't give the language switch the season switch's shape.
Don't hard-code a colour or a typeface in a component: both come from the theme.
